strategy: Enhance common/envelope.cue with AI features, keep backward compatibility
design_principles: Keep common/envelope.cue as primary source (used by protocol.cue)
Add AI features as optional fields to common types
Maintain backward compatibility for existing common envelope usage
Support both error handling approaches (array and optional object)
Unified next_actions that supports both simple and rich formats

additions: id?: string - correlation ID for request/response matching
options?: {timeout_ms?: int & >0, dry_run?: bool} - execution options
rename 'params' to 'args' for consistency (keep 'params' as alias)

changes: Add id?: string - echo correlation ID from request
Add success?: bool - boolean success indicator (complements status)
Add errors?: [...#Error] - error array for AI self-repair
Keep error?: #Error - for single error case
Add next_actions_rich?: [...#NextAction] - rich next actions with priority/reason
Add exit_code?: int to metadata - process exit code

definition.command: string - JSONL request as string or full #Request
definition.blocks: [...string]? - request IDs that must complete first

changes: Add fix_hint?: string - human-readable fix suggestion
Add tests for new optional fields (id, options, success, errors[])
Add tests for enhanced metadata with exit_code
Keep all existing tests for backward compatibility
